texts.zh:
[Leader.GetName]报告称，在[from.GetName]火山表面之下存在广袤的冰川，被隔热特性极佳的特殊矿物岩层包裹。构造活动正缓慢破坏这些隔热层，[Leader.GetName]预测，若冰川与星体其他区域温度趋于平衡，该行星将大幅降温，从火山星球转变为干旱星球，

我们可以加速此过程，提高其宜居性。不过该现象颇具科学价值，也可使其自然演，方便进行研究。
texts.en:
[Leader.GetName] reports that beneath the volcanic surface of [from.GetName] are vast glaciers. They are encased in unusual rock formations composed of minerals with exceptional insulating properties. Tectonic activity is slowly degrading these insulating layers, and [Leader.GetName] predicts that if temperatures between the glaciers and the rest of the planet were to equalize, the planet would cool enough to be considered an arid world, rather than a volcanic one.

We can speed up this process in order to make the planet somewhat more habitable. But the phenomenon is scientifically curious, and there may be value in allowing it to be studied as it proceeds naturally.
